vtable.extent_evidence: THREE independent reads agree on 36 slots. (1) Relocation gap: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/relocs.txt has a relocated word at every 4-byte address from 0x0213bbb0 (the typeinfo header word) through 0x0213bc40 inclusive, with an 8-byte gap immediately before (last prior reloc 0x0213bba8) and an 8-byte gap immediately after (next reloc 0x0213bc48) -- 36 relocated slot words. (2) Next-symbol read: the following symbols.txt row is data_ov006_0213bc44, giving a symbol extent of 0x0213bc44 - 0x0213bbb4 = 0x90 = 36 slots. Here the naive read AGREES with the relocation gap, because this table carries no interior phantom symbol and no butted _ZTI; neither rule is sound alone (writer.md), so the agreement of the two is the evidence, not either one. (3) tools/rtti_vtables.py --own dScMgBomroom_c reports `36 slots (base 36)`, and romdata_check.check_object on src/_ZN14dScMgBomroom_cD1Ev.cpp -- the shard that owns the key function and therefore emits the table -- reports _ZTV14dScMgBomroom_c bytes 144, emitted 144, romExtent 144, blindWords 0, VERIFIED. 144 = 0x90 = 36 slots. Storage (0x0213bbac..0x0213bc44 = 0x98) and symbol extent from the address point (0x90) differ by the 8-byte offset-to-top + typeinfo preamble; the _ZTV symbol IS the address point.
